Hasumi's later agreement to an explanation and practical cooperation need not be invented as an ideological conversion. During the Gourmet conflict, Hasumi and Ichika move toward force while Mika seeks dialogue; Izumi and Junko have their own reasons for care and acceptance of food. Hasumi's recognition-based culprit inference is not a trial finding, and a force threat is not a shown shot. The subsequent meal, cleanup and gratitude keep a useful response visible without removing suspicion or lost play time. [E48:003/006/007/009]

claims.joined_saved_paragraph: Christmas gives the most sustained test of inquiry and proportionality. Hasumi's recovery of an item is first misread as unjust taking because Mine blocks the explanation. The delinquents' deception is real, but their pain is not therefore imaginary. Hasumi reports coercive sales and threats once the cause becomes explicit; numerical heat and chemical claims remain attributed, as do the opponents' defensive rationalizations. Mine's useful care and the juniors' treatment are preserved alongside injuries caused by premature force. The opponents ultimately escape. Hasumi refuses a dramatic life repayment which would impose another extreme demand on the wronged group, accepts local treatment and recovery reports, and returns everyone to wanted company. Listening was not the error; halted inquiry and force on an incomplete case were. [E19:003–010]
claims.extension_limit: Deception not imaginary injury; toxicology and heat attributed; no arrest/restitution; listening not endorsement of force.
claims.directed_recipients_and_agency: Delinquents real pain and strategic plan; Mine intentions versus interrupted inquiry; juniors choices and treatment distinct.
claims.actual_endpoint_and_unfinished_coda: Opponents escape; reported local recovery/Hasumi rejects life repayment and invites the party.

claims.joined_saved_paragraph: Adult reassurance can have a real local benefit. She reports that the headache has gone, insists on the bakery visit and later thanks him. He shares park time, wakes her after overnight sleep and helps with the practical lemon task. But her subsequent caution against pressure, her desire to meet an ideal summer presentation and his own apology after the beach episode are consequential. Her denial of blame does not establish that the encouragement had no effect. Nor can concern authorize overruling every chosen purchase or meal. The relationship is ethically mixed because reassurance, attraction, dependence, desire and self-expectation interact while the actual results remain finite. [H01:13003:006/008; 16011:003; 10124:002–006]
claims.extension_limit: Reported relief not total cure; denied blame not proof of zero pressure; adult concern is not unlimited authority.
claims.directed_recipients_and_agency: Initiation, chosen company, purchase and food separate from reassurance/apology.
claims.actual_endpoint_and_unfinished_coda: Actual park, gift and meal; recurring diet caution and future visits unclosed.

claims.joined_saved_paragraph: Tsurugi is neither simply an intimidating tool nor an incompetent superior for Hasumi to replace. Hasumi takes on external festival responsibilities in response to Tsurugi's difficulty, interprets some nonlexical answers and offers reassurance about tense company. Yet venue negotiations expose her willingness to use that very intimidation. Tsurugi independently chooses easier outside guard work, protects others' rare rest, accepts hospitality in some circumstances and holds a rear guard with Hasumi. GROUP1802's sweets reception can feel welcoming to Tsurugi while the reader sees peers' fear; Hasumi's relief does not make all recipients comfortable. Nor does her interpretation of Tsurugi's Christmas reply become a complete verbalized assent. The relationship combines trust, practical accommodation, asymmetrical interpretation and ethically questionable deployment. [H01:16011 written; G01:1802; M03; E19:006–011]
claims.extension_limit: Hasumi interpreter not total assent; Tsurugi felt welcome not all peer comfort; no commander replacement identity.
claims.directed_recipients_and_agency: Tsurugi chooses outside work, guarding and rest and actual rear guard; Hasumi accommodation/intimidation both.
claims.actual_endpoint_and_unfinished_coda: Actual practical reciprocity and felt welcome versus fear; later party replies qualified.

claims.joined_saved_paragraph: Hasumi's language makes an argument about the order of responsibilities: students precede workers, and voluntary club membership does not abolish enjoyment. The notebook's concrete particulars protect this from becoming a generic kindness slogan. At Christmas, knowledge is presented as enriching pleasure rather than granting permission to have it. In the dispute, admitting 回収 does not admit the stronger 奪う accusation. Justice as an institutional name cannot settle whether its own act was just, just as Mine's 救護 vocabulary cannot make every corrective attack care. These textual distinctions explain the conflicts more accurately than an English paraphrase which converts every retrieval into theft or every rescue into benign treatment. [H01:13003:015; E19:006/009; E19:checkpoint:L118]
claims.extension_limit: Recovery admission not theft concession; rescue/justice words not ethical certificate for acts.
claims.directed_recipients_and_agency: Hasumi teaches ordinary access; Mine contested semantic extension; recipients kept.
claims.actual_endpoint_and_unfinished_coda: Printed lexical distinctions explain conflict, no legal judgment.

claims.joined_saved_paragraph: The final rival is a success metric in which rest exists only after all duties and harms are resolved. That would exclude most of the represented life: a sixth-place relay can be exhilarating, a tiring day can offer company, Christmas can end in a real party while opponents escape, and a facilitated summer can still leave the facilitator's own holiday unfinished. The inverse metric, counting every happy ending as complete repair, is equally defective. Actual pleasure and unfinished obligation can coexist. Keeping both is the central explanatory gain of the monograph. [E18:019; E19:010–011; E03:014; H01:10124:005/006]
claims.extension_limit: Pleasure not contingent on all harms being resolved; happy end not full repair/restful holiday completed.
claims.directed_recipients_and_agency: Every quiet want intrinsically valued, peers and her different benefits retained.
claims.actual_endpoint_and_unfinished_coda: Actual local good ends plus leave/volleyball/restitution/reform unfulfilled.
